cases.scenario: After the documented deletion completion, an unprivileged fixture user still downloads the deleted private canary through an old export endpoint.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm the violated access contract and actual copy; do not claim all backups or media remain exposed.

cases.scenario: An owner-restricted archival copy remains under an explicitly documented retention policy and cannot be reached by prohibited actors.
cases.expected_decision: Do not infer public exposure or a legal violation from retention alone.

cases.scenario: A UI hides a record but no requirement establishes purge or access-revocation timing.
cases.expected_decision: Record the missing contract and exact observed behavior; avoid inventing a deletion guarantee.
